intro: Our Grande dining table makes hosting easy. With its extended layout and timeless form, it sets the scene for everything from Sunday brunches to festive feasts.

features.title: Our table brings people together
features.text: We designed it to comfortably host your family and friends. Its extended layout offers generous space so no one feels squeezed—only welcomed.

features.title: A top that stands up to life
features.text: Crafted with a smooth MDF surface, our tabletop resists stains, wear, and heat—so it handles everything from school projects to dinner parties with ease.

features.title: Built strong with real wood
features.text: With a solid rubberwood frame, our table stays firm and stable through years of use, no matter how lively the gathering.

features.title: Toned for everyday elegance
features.text: The rich cappuccino finish isn’t just stylish—it blends beautifully with both modern and traditional settings, bringing warmth and depth to your dining space.

features.title: Clean lines that create calm
features.text: Its minimalist, rectangular form helps your room feel structured yet open. We’ve eliminated cluttered details to focus on balance, flow, and comfort.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
